extracted.intended_audience: researchers/authors considering submission to BMC Medicine; biomedical and sociomedical researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and high-level criteria for manuscripts considered by BMC Medicine, including scope, peer-review model, editorial responsiveness, and participation in themed collections. Intended to orient authors and readers about the journal's expectations and processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / topical coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: We cover all areas of clinical practice, translational medicine, medical and health advances, public health, global health, policy, and general topics of interest to our global readership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should fall within these domains and be of interest to biomedical and sociomedical professional communities; the journal publishes across a broad range of clinical and health-related topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance and broad interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishing outstanding and influential research of broad interest to the biomedical and sociomedical professional communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are expected to be high-impact, influential, and of broad relevance rather than narrowly specialized or incremental.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access and open peer review model
rubrics_metrics.description: BMC Medicine is an open access, open peer review medical journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer review is transparent (open peer review) and articles are published open access; authors should expect reviewer identities/comments to be handled consistent with the journal's open-peer-review policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial rigour and responsiveness / rapid processing
rubrics_metrics.description: BMC Medicine's highly responsive team of professional editors ensure rigorous processes and rapid publication upon acceptance. Submission to first decision (median) 3 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal emphasizes prompt editorial handling and rapid decisions; authors can expect efficient triage and decision timelines (median first decision ~3 days).

rubrics_metrics.name: Portable Peer Review / transfer of external reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: We aim to expedite the decision-making process for manuscripts with reviews received at high-tier journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors may be able to transfer previously obtained reviews from other high-tier journals to accelerate editorial decisions; the journal uses portable peer review to reduce redundant review cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Themed collections / solicited topical submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: BMC Medicine issues Calls for papers for Collections (e.g., Impacts of social media and digital technologies on children and adolescents; Treatment and management of MASH/MASLD; Ultra-processed food and health).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions aligned to active collections or calls are solicited and may have specific topical focus and deadlines; authors should check collection scopes and deadlines when submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author support, visibility and dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: We are dedicated to supporting our authors by providing global visibility, innovative formats, widespread promotion, and opportunities for impact on future research, practice, and policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal prioritizes promotion and dissemination of accepted work through various formats and channels to maximize reach and policy/practice impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal performance/quality indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Journal Impact Factor 8.3 (2024); 5-year Journal Impact Factor 9.4 (2024); Downloads 10.4M (2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These metrics signal the journal's visibility and influence and may inform authors' choice of venue, but do not substitute for manuscript-specific suitability and quality criteria.
